target_customer: Airports, critical infrastructure operators, defense forces and venues needing to detect small drones
problem: Cheap small drones are hard for conventional radar to see, leaving airports, infrastructure and front lines exposed.
business_model: Sale of radar sensor hardware and systems to defense and infrastructure buyers

technical_complexity.rationale: High-frequency radar design that detects very low signature targets needs deep RF expertise; founders come from a university millimetre-wave group that has built drone radars since 2016.

defensibility.rationale: RF know-how and the university research lineage are hard to copy, but better funded rivals are building the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Radar rivals raised large rounds in 2025; a report says Shield agreed to buy Echodyne for $5.3B, showing buyers value the segment.

market_need_then: Drone threats to airports and the front line were rising, defense funding for counter-UAS grew, and counter-UAS startups raised over $1.2B between Q1 2025 and Q1 2026 per one tracker.

branding.name_origin: Likely a reference to millimeter-wave radar (site does not say).

identity.visual_style: Minimal bold layout with live detection visual and orange ring markers

rebrands.why: Not stated; YC page and a UK trade mark filing still use DroneTector

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand; two names are in use, which splits recognition.

outcome_analysis: Milliray, formerly DroneTector, is a Winter 2026 company from a St Andrews radar group with academic and defense program support. It is early with no verified round, selling into a hot counter-drone market where radar rivals raised very large rounds, so its outcome depends on field proof and defense procurement.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights lists $620K total, VCBacked $500K, Preqin a June 2026 seed from Pioneer Fund and YC without amount. Founding year and location conflict across aggregators, so left null. Support from DASA, NATO DIANA and RAEng is stated on the company site and YC page but no amounts.
